{{Top|leg}}
A '''vengeance party''' was a [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] custom. If two Ranat hunting parties engaged in combat, the result was either [[Death/Legends|death]] or escape. Surviving members of the conflict would then organize a vengeance party in order to restore their honor. These parties were gala affairs for the Ranat's tribe, as each member of the town would assist in preparation even if only a small handful of individuals actually enacted the revenge plan.
